conjunction: the indicative for a plain fact, the subjunctive for what is expected, intended or prevented

In this lexicon

  • before

    the recommended word · classical · Sen. Ep. 87.1: naufragium antequam nāvem ascenderem fēcī; Varr. RR 1.1.1: ut sarcinās conligam, antequam proficīscar ē vītā

Examples

  • naufragium antequam nāvem ascenderem fēcī

    I was shipwrecked before I had even got on boardSen. Ep. 87.1
